**Best move:** Qxe5

**Main line:** Qxe5 Qe7 Nxf6 Qxf6 Qxc7

**Motif:** hangingPiece (the e5 pawn is undefended and attacked twice; after the forcing sequence White wins material)

**Coaching Note for the Club Player:**

Black's e5 pawn is attacked twice (your queen and knight) and only once defended. Before recapturing it, calculate the forcing sequence: your queen takes, Black defends by moving the queen to e7, you capture the knight with check, Black recaptures, then you win the c7 pawn. You gain material and a winning position. **Lesson:** Always check if a hanging piece leads to a forcing sequence that wins even more material—don't just make the simple capture.
